name: cypress-example
description: Example Cypress project demonstrating qa-shadow-report integration

scripts.cypress:run: npm run cypress:prerun && cypress run --headless --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=cypress/results,overwrite=false,html=false,json=true --quiet || true
scripts.report:merge: mochawesome-merge cypress/results/*.json > cypress/results/output.json && npm run report:generate
